A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''woman''' of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] ancestry gave birth to at least one of four [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Reproduction/Legends|fathered]] by the [[Morellian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and outdoorsman [[Barosa Warren]]. Among the children were the [[Gender/Legends|males]] [[Tole Warren]], [[Alton Lochner]], and [[Roland Warren]], and the female [[Danlea Lochner]], all Morellian&ndash;Human [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrids]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
While ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' notes that Barosa Warren's children had Human mothers, it does not mention whether Warren was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to either woman. Similarly, the source mentions no birth years for the children, so, coupled with their mixed-species heritage, it is unclear whether Warren's partner lived during the latter years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], or both.<ref name="AIR" />
